title: EFC vs ΛCDM: Complete Kill-Test — From Rotation Curves to Planck: A Consistent Low-Dimensional Alternative
description: Comprehensive kill-test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) versus ΛCDM across six probes from galaxy rotation curves to CMB, BAO, and SNe. Using a single action with two global field parameters (K0, m^2), EFC jointly predicts μ≈0.94 and Σ≈1.05 from one mechanism (stiffness + slip) and achieves Δχ^2 ≤ 0 across four cobaya minimize runs. The results indicate EFC cannot be rejected by current data; full MCMC with Bayes evidence is identified as the remaining decisive test.

mu_of_k.description: Scale-dependent modification of the Poisson equation; stiffness suppresses the effective gravitational coupling.

R_k.description: Stiffness response controlling \mu(k); yields R \propto k^{-4} so GR is recovered on small (galactic/solar-system) scales.

theta_rho.description: Density regulator bridging cosmological and galactic regimes; \Theta \to 1 at low densities, \Theta \to 0 in dense environments.

slip_fraction_f.description: Gravitational slip fraction induced by the restoring potential versus stiffness; controls \eta and \Sigma.

predictive_chain.description: Two field parameters drive the complete observable chain: K0 fixes \mu; m^2 sets slip f which determines \eta and \Sigma.

key_results.main_finding: Across six probes and four cobaya minimize runs, EFC with two global parameters (K0 ≈ 1.55–1.68, m^2 ≈ 0.0032–0.0038) delivers μ≈0.94 and Σ≈1.05 and achieves Δχ^2 ≤ 0 versus GR/ΛCDM; EFC cannot be rejected by current data.

sealed_predictions.statement: High-ℓ CMB TT+TE+EE analyses with MG-enabled pipelines will prefer a non-GR slip with Σ0 ≈ 1.05 (and η ≈ 1.23) corresponding to f ≈ 0.15.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-precision high-ℓ CMB likelihoods (e.g., Planck reanalyses, SPT/ACT/CMB-S4) jointly fitting (μ0, Σ0) or (K0, m^2).

sealed_predictions.statement: BAO + CMB lensing + growth-rate data analyzed without high-ℓ TTTEEE will recover a stiffness signal μ(k=0.05 h/Mpc) ≈ 0.94.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint BAO + CMB lensing + RSD datasets with MG parameterization, excluding high-ℓ temperature/polarization.

sealed_predictions.statement: At the EFC best fit, the amplitude of matter fluctuations is suppressed by ≈1.4% relative to GR (σ8 ↓), with a small H0 upshift (~+0.9 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹) and Ωm slightly reduced.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Combined weak-lensing (cosmic shear) and RSD constraints on σ8 and Ωm, and CMB+distance-ladder constraints on H0.

sealed_predictions.statement: GR is recovered in dense/short-scale regimes (μ→1, Σ→1) due to Θ(ρ)→0, implying no measurable deviations in Solar System tests.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Solar System PPN constraints (e.g., Cassini, tracking, ephemerides) or strong-field tests detecting |μ−1| > 10⁻⁵ at k ≳ 50 h/Mpc.

sealed_predictions.statement: A single global pair (K0, m^2) fits rotation curves across SPARC galaxies without per-galaxy halo parameters.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Multi-galaxy rotation-curve refits (SPARC) failing to achieve acceptable AIC/χ² with one global (K0, m^2).

kill_criteria: KC1: Full MCMC with Bayes evidence on Planck 2018 (plik_lite + lowℓ + lensing) + BAO + Pantheon+ decisively prefers GR/ΛCDM over EFC (e.g., Δχ² > 0 and Bayes factor strong against EFC).
KC2: SPARC rotation-curve ensemble cannot be fit with a single global pair (K0, m^2) at acceptable χ²/AIC without per-galaxy halo parameters.
KC3: Joint constraints tightly exclude μ(k=0.05 h/Mpc)=0.94 and Σ0≈1.05 at ≥3σ (i.e., μ→1 and Σ→1 favored with sufficient precision).
KC4: Inconsistency of (K0, m^2) estimates across independent probe subsets (e.g., BAO+lensing vs high-ℓ CMB) beyond quoted uncertainties, violating the low-dimensional global-parameter claim.
KC5: Detection of non-GR effects in Solar System regimes implying Θ(ρ)≠0 at high densities (e.g., |μ−1| > 10⁻⁵ at k ≳ 50 h/Mpc), contradicting GR recovery.

related_packages.role: Localization and MGCAMB implementation establishing (μ, Σ) mapping

epistemic_status: Comprehensive kill-test across six probes; Δχ² ≤ 0 in EFC direction across all four cobaya runs; awaiting full MCMC for Layer C
abstract: Comprehensive kill-test of Energy-Flow Cosmology against ΛCDM across six independent probes spanning galactic to cosmological scales. A single action with two field parameters (K0, m²) produces μ = 0.94, η = 1.23, Σ = 1.05 from one mechanism — stiffness and slip are not independent. All four cobaya minimize runs against Planck 2018 plik_lite + lowl + lensing + BAO + Pantheon+ return Δχ² ≤ 0 in the EFC direction. EFC cannot be rejected on current data.
